rewithered.config.witherSkeletonTweaks.r: Replace skeletons in soul sand valley
When enabled, wither skeletons will spawn instead of skeletons in soul sand valleys.
When enabled, wither skeletons will spawn instead of skeletons in nether fortresses.
rewithered.config.witherSkeletonTweaks.u: Use bows in soul sand valley
When enabled, wither skeletons spawned in soul sand valleys will have a chance to wield a bow instead of a stone sword.
When enabled, wither skeletons spawned in nether fortresses will have a chance to wield a bow instead of a stone sword.
rewithered.config.witherSkeletonTweaks.s: Bow chance in soul sand valley (%)
Percent chance for a wither skeleton to spawn with a bow in soul sand valleys.
rewithered.config.witherSkeletonTweaks.f: Percent chance for a wither skeleton to spawn with a bow in nether fortresses.
rewithered.config.witherSkeletonTweaks.s: When enabled, wither skeletons wielding a bow will shoot wither arrows instead of flaming arrows.
rewithered.config.witherSkeletonTweaks.d: When enabled, wither skeletons wielding a bow will drop wither arrows on death.
rewithered.config.witherSkeletonTweaks.s: When enabled, wither skeletons will have a chance to spawn with armor, just like regular skeletons.
When enabled, wither skeletons will have a chance to spawn with enchanted weapons and armor, just like regular skeletons.
